title: Evidence-Delta Lifecycle Gate + Distribution/Strength Separation

examples.finding: State strengthened although current evidence exposes one independent source and 75% reprints.
State strengthened with one independent source and two reprints.

live_evidence.ai_c_evidence: EXP-C-019 independently flags lifecycle churn vs independent evidence; causal effect/probability remain UNKNOWN.

hypothesis: Lifecycle strength should be a transition over new independent evidence and verified market confirmation, not a label inferred from refresh/article-count churn. Distribution velocity is useful but must be a separate axis.

architecture.transition_gate: A positive evidence-strength transition requires a point-in-time delta: new independent origin, new/updated primary evidence, materially new claim/action, or separately validated market confirmation. Reprints may change distribution_state only.
architecture.abstention: If PIT inputs or semantic membership are insufficient, preserve prior evidence state and mark the relevant axis UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN rather than manufacture strengthening.
architecture.pages_ux: Show '근거 강도' separately from '보도 확산'. Display independent-source delta, reprint count, last genuinely new evidence time, and why a transition occurred.

validation_handoff.request: Chronological PIT comparison: current lifecycle vs independent-source-delta baseline vs NEWS-013 multi-axis gate. Measure false strengthening, transition precision, reactivation precision, stale-alert FP, material-event miss rate, precision@3/5/10, and coverage-vs-abstention. Ablate primary delta, novel-claim delta, market confirmation and distribution.

falsification_handoff.request: Attack GN-25b0e75405c01734 and GN-0aee31dfa810ce16 chronology. Look for cases where reprint velocity itself contains genuine new information, one authoritative source is sufficient, corrections reduce strength, or umbrella events make independent-origin counts misleading.

sre_handoff.request: Only after validation demand: persist PIT transition inputs/deltas and reason codes; make rebuild idempotent. Do not let refresh alone create evidence delta. Keep closed-session reaction guard independent.

small_works.note: EXP-C-019 confirms reprint/independence sensitivity but does not yet validate NEWS-012 OOS.
AI-D ACTIVE and owns P1; no Secondary Recovery.
Canonical review still lacks actions_result/expected_state verification; do not duplicate AI-D work.

rejection_criteria: No OOS reduction in false strengthening versus independent-source-delta baseline
Improvement comes only from excessive abstention
Future evidence is required to reproduce transitions
Distribution axis adds no utility beyond independent-source delta
